text:
Lucia: Dropping a compact-version mock for the roles matrix — goal is faster scan for admins, but keep role details discoverable.

Ethan: Saw it. Main idea works. Suggest 'mini-hints' under role name (1 short phrase) instead of full description rows. Keeps density low.

Priya: Accessibility note: those hints must be reachable via keyboard and announced to screen readers. Don't rely on hover. Add a small 'More info' button per role (aria-controls -> expands inline).

Kai: For the 'Enforce SSO' control, prefer concise copy: 'Enforce SSO 14 recommended.' Add a tiny tertiary link: 'View SSO events' that deep-links to audit with a pre-filter.

Emilia: Backend can expose counts for the pre-filter so the CTA can show "View SSO events (12)". Deep-link example: `/orgs/123/audit?filter=event_type%3Asso.enforce` (URL-encoded).

Ethan: Implementation note: lazy-render expanded details for big orgs, but include an offscreen summary for screenreaders so SR users don't miss content while we lazy-load.

Priya: Good — offscreen sr-only node with the brief description and a link to expand would be ideal. When expanded, focus should go to the panel heading (tabindex=-1) and Esc should close.

Lucia: Also, avoid placing the audit CTA only in the toolbar. Put the quick-filter CTA next to the SSO control and also keep the top-right Audit link. Redundancy helps discoverability.

Kai: Will wire the frontend deep-link to `/orgs/:id/audit?filter=event_type%3Asso.enforce`. We'll ensure the filter token is URL-encoded and the audit page highlights the query.

ui-bot: Mock uploaded: https://figma.redwood.com/file/xyz789/roles-compact-mini-hints — comments enabled.

Emilia: Action items: Ethan update mock with mini-hints + sr-only summary; Priya prepare a11y checklist for expanders and modal; Kai implement deep-link and audit-count badge; Lucia schedule quick unmoderated test next week.

Lucia: Thanks. Keep copy punchy (one-liners) in the modal explaining SSO and mention the `sso.enforce` audit tag.
